title: Putin's post-9/11 proposal to unite against common threats, including cosmic ones

tellings.quote: But on the other hand, there are good and not so good extraterrestrials, right? Some of them might even want to enslave our earth.

plain: After the September 11 attacks in 2001, the Russian president Vladimir Putin is said to have proposed that nations unite against shared threats, including threats from space, warning that there are "good and not so good extraterrestrials" and that some "might even want to enslave our earth." A man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, tells Michels this in 2025, passing on what he says Putin said. If true, it would mean a world leader treated alien threats as a real matter of security.
